blocks.text: Harbor & Oak Liquid theme design

This is the working cut for HBR-TDD-2020-021 on August 4, 2020. Jenna Park asked for a written bound after the current path (Debut fork on theme-preview.harbor.internal, unpublished) stopped being honest. I am Michael Gilfilian, Web Developer, writing for Dana Whitlock, Jenna Park, and Nia Brooks. Primary host theme-preview.harbor.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on CSS hide on the shipping radio for pickup, then open questions. If you are implementing next week, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the commands or contracts.

Pickup is a cart attribute plus a shipping rate name Dana already has in Shopify. Not a CSS hide. Metafields for fabric and fit. I am not restating a hallway yes. CSS hide on the shipping radio for pickup is out because Shopify checkout CSS is not a contract. Jenna watched it break on a preview theme in July. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: look at sections=9, metafields=2, lcp=2.11, preview=3, hide=1, weeks=5, skus=412, photos=840. Sibling tickets HBR-1104 and HBR-REQ-2020-008. I will not reopen CSS hide on the shipping radio for pickup in a side thread because a vendor sent a discount. Jenna Park is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.

blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Nia Brooks owns a leftover that is easy to skip: cdn-preview.harbor.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (10): refuse on CSS hide on the shipping radio for pickup, lock is sections JSON, two metafields, cart attribute pickup_store. I will not hide a product change inside a 'quick align' on HBR-1104.
If pickup is a CSS hide on the shipping radio, it will break the first time Shopify ships a checkout change.

What a skeptical user would try first on theme-preview.harbor.internal: the path Jenna Park actually has, not a desktop demo. Metric I will argue is time-to-useful, not a vanity QPS. If we cannot show that path on shop.harbor.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Michael Gilfilian will not accept a laptop screenshot as that proof.
